text:
tess: heads-up: customers reporting tricky behavior when our automatic fallback flips during quota throttles. they see degraded outputs and ops can't tell which degrade-mode was used. we need clearer operator/diagnostic UX.

omar: can we expose a short degrade-mode badge on the route header (e.g., [soft-suppress], [partial-proxy], [full-fallback]) + a one-line cause? avoids clicking into logs.

kyle: love the badge. also propose a tiny "reconciliation" action: attempts a safe, short-lived routing change that keeps X% traffic on the fallback for 30s then returns. effectively a canary undo in-place. must be auditable.

lin: reconcile sounds risky. we should attach a safety policy: only allowed if last 2 minutes show error_rate <= baseline+0.03 and p95_latency delta <= 10%. otherwise button disabled and show reason tooltip.

deploy-bot: build queued: autofallback-badges-reconcile -> staging

tess: audit requirements: every badge change, reconcile attempt, and fallback event needs an immutable audit entry with operator, timestamp, machine-reason-code, and a snapshot id pointing to telemetry. snapshots store top error classes, recent traces, and quota-window stats. retention 180d.

omar: telemetry: add a "quota-context" object to fallback events: {window_start, window_end, token_budget, throttle_pct}. that will help distinguish quota-induced fallbacks vs model errors. machine-reason-code should append :Quota or :Model for filtering.

kyle: UX: on route detail page show a small timeline strip with colored segments for degrade modes over last 15m. hover shows the snapshot id and one-line summary. clicking snapshot opens a side panel with anonymized sample requests + histogram.

lin: API sketch for reconcile: POST /v1/routing/{route_id}/reconcile
{ "attempt_pct": 10, "duration_secs": 30, "operator_reason": "reconcile:reduce-noise" }
Response: { "reconcile_id": "r-abc123", "safety_pass": true, "estimated_impact": { "error_delta": -0.02 } }
tess: make reconcile_id linkable so the audit entry can point to it. also auto-create incident stub when reconcile fails safety checks.

omar: backend: reconcile runner should replay a small sampled stream with routing change in a sandbox and score metrics. we can run it async and return quick estimate; full result posts to audit when ready. limit reconcile runs per-route to 1 per 5m.

kyle: can we add a "why did this fallback happen" quick explain flow? show top three signals (errors, mem pressure, quota) in priority order with weights. helps ops decide whether reconcile is safe.

lin: agreed. signal weights come from the decision engine; we'll add a human-readable summary and the machine codes. security: only rollout:operator can trigger reconcile, rollout:viewer sees badges and snapshots. audit logs record session id and IP.

deploy-bot: ticket opened: ENGOPS-7124 (reconcile action + degrade badges + quota context)

tess: next: lin to spec safety checks and snapshot schema, omar to add quota-context to fallback event, kyle to mock timeline strip and reconcile button copy. i'll update runbook with reconcile playbook notes.

omar: small experiment: enable reconcile badge on 20% of internal routes and measure change in mean time to recover and number of manual rollbacks avoided.

kyle: one more: include a small "audit playback" link on snapshots that replays anonymized request flow in the debug sandbox — useful for post-mortems.

lin: ok. i'll draft schema and IAM constraints. aiming to post RFC by EOD tomorrow. :calendar:
